messages.text: How do I deploy our API on Kubernetes without maintaining lots of YAML?
Use the Helm chart in the deploy folder. Try helm upgrade --install api ./deploy/chart.
That Helm command solved the Kubernetes deployment issue, thanks!
What is the recommended way to scale the Kubernetes cluster?
For cluster scaling use the autoscaler. The docs recommend setting requests before enabling autoscaling.
The monitoring dashboard shows high memory after enabling Kubernetes autoscaling.
Try adjusting memory requests. That usually fixes autoscaling decisions and dashboard noise.
The memory requests fix worked. We should add it to the Kubernetes docs.
